newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures supported by firm overseas market.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures supported by firm overseas market.

text.p: Firm French grains prices on Friday following the result of the European Union (EU) weekly tender supported UK LIFFE wheat futures.
French prices rose after the EU cleared the export of 500,000 tonnes of wheat at Thursday's tender.
UK wheat futures closed with gains of 0.25 to 0.75 stg after trading 729 lots.
May was the most active position trading 316 lots before closing 0.75 stg up at 104.00 stg.
Barley finished 0.25 stg up after trading nine lots.
